# share alike

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:actionShareAlike`](gmeow-actionShareAlike.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/actionShareAlike>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

Distribute derivatives under the same licence ([odrl:shareAlike](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/shareAlike); [cc:ShareAlike](http://creativecommons.org/ns#ShareAlike)) — typically the action of a share-alike duty.
